title: Cultural Bias and Cultural Alignment of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the LLMs' cultural values on the 'Traditional vs. Secular-Rational' dimension of the Inglehart-Welzel Cultural Map. This dimension is partially determined by the model's response to the World Values Survey question on the 'Importance of God' (F063), where secular values correspond to less emphasis on religion.
findings: All tested models exhibit cultural values resembling English-speaking and Protestant European countries, which tend to be more secular. There is significant variation between models on the traditional-secular axis, which measures the emphasis on religion. GPT-3.5-turbo and GPT-4o express more secular values, a shift potentially influenced by Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF), while other models like GPT-4-turbo express more traditional values. This indicates a measurable, but inconsistent, bias towards secularism in the models' outputs.
